opportunities.name: arXiv paper to Semantic Scholar citation note
opportunities.description: Search arXiv advanced search for a topic restricted to a specific year, open the top result, look up its title on Semantic Scholar, and save a note with topic, year, title, first author and citation count.
steps: Open arXiv Search > Advanced search
Enter the search term
Tick the date filter, choose specific year and enter the year
Click Search and open the first result
Copy the paper title
Search the title on Semantic Scholar and open the paper
Read the first author and citation count
Add a note: '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <n> citations'

opportunities.name: Court case to statute reference note
opportunities.description: Search CourtListener for a case, open it, look up a related US Code section on Cornell LII, and save a note with citation, decision date and statute.
steps: On CourtListener go to Case Law > Search Case Law
Enter the case name and press Enter
Open the matching case result and read the citation and decision date
On Cornell LII search the statute citation and open the section
Add a note: '<case>: <reporter cite>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<title>)'

opportunities.name: Peerspace venue search by activity and city
opportunities.description: Enter an activity and a city on Peerspace, select the autocomplete option and run the search.
steps: Click the activity field, select all and type the activity
Click the location field, select all and type the city
Choose the matching autocomplete option
Click Search
